name: attn
description: Attn — keyboard-first, local-first desktop email client for macOS and Windows
author: Attn contributors

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.e2e:perf: npm run build && npm run e2e:perf:only --
scripts.e2e:perf:only: node scripts/generate-perf-seed.mjs && node scripts/generate-perf-seed.mjs --messages=50000 --second-account=0 --output=e2e/.generated/perf-search-seed.json && node scripts/run-e2e.mjs --perf --grep @perf --grep-invert @perfscale
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npx biome ci . && npm run test:unit && npm run e2e
scripts.package:dir: npm run package:clean && npm run package:metadata && npm run build && electron-builder --dir && npm run package:verify
scripts.package:mac: npm run package:clean && npm run package:metadata && npm run build && electron-builder --mac && npm run package:verify
scripts.package:mac:all: npm run package:clean && npm run package:metadata && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64 && npm run package:verify
scripts.package:win: npm run package:clean && npm run package:metadata && npm run build && electron-builder --win && npm run package:verify
scripts.release:mac: npm run package:clean && npm run package:metadata && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64 --publish never && npm run package:verify -- --release
scripts.release:win: npm run package:clean && npm run package:metadata && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never && npm run package:verify -- --release
scripts.e2e:perf:scale: npm run build && npm run e2e:perf:scale:only --
